candidate_decisions.reason: All eight nominated branches land in the supplied focus wording: recitation and hearing meet the ear and weight images, while turning and self-elevation make the blocked reception an enacted refusal. The local reading remains intelligible without claiming a recurring surah-wide channel.
The favorable announcement carrier is paired with explicit punishment and pain, activating the supplied bad-content or ironic-reversal facet and the punitive and felt-pain branches.

Every HFT trace coordinate agrees with the supplied 31:6 or 31:7 surface and its stated role, and the trace returns through the focus hearing and ear-weight words. The five context branches remain attributed because their registry records are unresolved and the HFT source is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: Recited signs meet a loaded ear
findings.claim: As the signs are recited, hearing can extend into understanding and acceptance; the pictured weight in the ears, the proud turn, and the ordered response make the failure of uptake read as enacted refusal.
findings.mechanism: The recited-sign carrier at 31:7:2:1 meets the explicit hearing at 31:7:9:1 and the physical ear at 31:7:12:1. The separate weight at 31:7:13:1, turning at 31:7:5:1, and self-elevating stance at 31:7:6:1 connect blocked reception to a chosen response. The temporal and consequent framing also lets the recitation's follow-after facet meet the turn and announcement that follow it.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene can be heard as more than a message that fails to arrive: an offered sequence reaches the hearing apparatus, while acceptance remains possible and the addressee turns away with the ear pictured as burdened.
findings.containment: The ordinary recitation and turning-away scene stays intact. The weight remains a simile rather than a diagnosis of deafness, and the acceptance reading is bounded to the contact among these words; no recurring channel is claimed.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus occurrences and reviewed facets ground the relation, while the channel synthesis is a first-pass interpretive connection and the self-elevation branch is marked qualified in the packet.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel gönderge, canlıların işitmeye yarayan kulak organıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أُذُنَيْهِ names the addressee's two physical ears, the organs that receive sound.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate wording says the signs are recited to him and imagines him as though he did not hear them.
branch_activations.activation: The recited signs and hearing verb meet the literal ear noun, placing the failure of reception in the hearing organ itself.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The refusal is staged through the actual hearing apparatus before the verse adds the image of weight.
branch_activations.boundary: This facet names the organ; it does not itself mean attentive listening, comprehension, permission, or approval.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel eylem, bir söze dikkat yönelterek onu dinlemektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The ear noun can carry the related act of giving speech attentive reception.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate recitation and hearing words put speech and directed listening together in the focus.
branch_activations.activation: The physical ear meets the stated act of hearing recited signs, allowing the organ to stand for receptivity to speech.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The image includes the possibility of listening attentively, which makes the following refusal perceptible as failed reception.
branch_activations.boundary: This core facet is attentive listening; it does not by itself entail acceptance or obedience.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bazı bağlamlarda dinleme, duyulanı kabul etmeyi ve buyruğa uymayı da içerir.
branch_activations.carrier: The ear is the image-bearing form for receptivity to the recited words.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate hearing clause is followed by a turn away and an explicitly self-elevating stance.
branch_activations.activation: The hearing possibility meets the addressee's turn and pride, so listening's possible extension into acceptance and compliance is precisely what the scene withholds.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The failure can be read as refusal of uptake, not only absence of sound perception.
branch_activations.boundary: Acceptance and obedience are contextual extensions here; the ear word does not carry them in every use.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir varlık ya da eylem, önce gelen bir başka şeye bağlı olarak ardından gelir.
branch_activations.carrier: تُتْلَىٰ carries the supplied follow-after facet alongside its ordinary recited-presentation reading.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The plural signs are presented in an ordered temporal frame, and the turning and consequential announcement follow the recitation.
branch_activations.activation: The sequence marked by the separate signs, turn, and consequent clause gives the follow-after facet an event structure to meet.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recitation can be perceived as an ordered presentation to follow through, whose course the addressee interrupts by turning away.
branch_activations.boundary: The ordinary local reading remains recitation; the sequence facet does not claim that the addressee actually followed the signs.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ses, kulak aracılığıyla fark edilir ve işitsel algıya dönüşür.
branch_activations.carrier: يَسْمَعْهَا is the explicit hearing verb, with its object referring back to the signs.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The signs are recited and the second simile places weight inside the addressee's ears.
branch_activations.activation: The recited sound, hearing verb, and ear-weight image meet across separate words, making the auditory channel the scene's point of contact.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Nonhearing is pictured as a failure in the route by which recited signs would be heard.
branch_activations.boundary: This facet remains auditory perception; understanding and obedience belong to the separately reviewed branch.

branch_activations.carrier: The hearing verb carries the possibility that the recited words are understood.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus gives the verb the recited signs as its object and then pictures weight obstructing the ears.
branch_activations.activation: The signs' content and the blockage image meet the hearing verb, allowing hearing to reach toward grasping their meaning.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The simile can imply a failure to take in what is said as well as a failure of sound reception.
branch_activations.boundary: The core is understanding the heard words; it does not by itself establish acceptance or action.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Anlama, sözü kabul etme ve ona uygun davranma sonucuna uzanabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The hearing verb can carry uptake of the recited message.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate turn away and self-elevating stance accompany the image of ear-weight.
branch_activations.activation: The possibility of understanding meets actions that cut off listening and compliance, activating the branch's contextual extension into accepting and following what is heard.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The addressee's nonhearing can be heard as non-acceptance and noncompliance within the scene.
branch_activations.boundary: This extension is contextual and coexists with the sensory hearing image; it does not replace it.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ululuk, üstünlük ve başkalarından yukarıda olma düşüncesi anlamın temel eksenidir.
branch_activations.carrier: مُسْتَكْبِرًا carries the supplied greatness and superiority axis.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate turn-away and simulated nonhearing are the behaviors alongside which the stance is presented.
branch_activations.activation: The superiority carrier meets bodily withdrawal from the recited signs, connecting the stance to refusal of reception.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Turning away is framed by an attitude of placing oneself above what is recited.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the self-superiority axis, not leadership, social rank, or the magnification of God.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanda bu eksen, kendini beğenme, başkalarından üstün sayma ve büyüklük taslama biçiminde gerçekleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The human participle مُسْتَكْبِرًا presents the addressee in a self-exalting stance.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: His turn away and the blocked-hearing similes supply the conduct that this personal specialization colors.
branch_activations.activation: Self-asserted superiority meets refusal to hear, making the act of turning away a way of enacting that stance.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The refusal reads as proud self-elevation rather than a neutral change of direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The specialization is limited to this human stance in the supplied clause; no further motive is inferred.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel durum, kulakta işitmeyi ağırlaştıran ve sesin alınmasını engelleyebilen bir bozukluktur.
branch_activations.carrier: وَقْرًا is placed inside the two ears as a weight or impediment to hearing.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate hearing verb is negated in the first simile, and the ear noun supplies the location for the second.
branch_activations.activation: The weight word meets both the hearing verb and the stated ear location, activating the branch's sound-blocking facet.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The apparent nonhearing becomes an image of heaviness lodged in the auditory channel.
branch_activations.boundary: The verse gives a simile, not a medical diagnosis or a claim of permanent deafness.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Dönüp uzaklaşma, yüz çevirme veya dinleme ve uyma bağını kesme.
branch_activations.carrier: وَلَّىٰ carries turning away from what is being presented.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate nonhearing and ear-weight images, together with the self-elevating stance, show what the turn cuts off.
branch_activations.activation: The bodily turn meets the refusal-of-hearing image, allowing physical turning and disengagement from listening to operate together.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The refusal is enacted by the body as well as imagined in the ears.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus supports turning away and severing attention here; no authority, support, or other branch meaning is imported.

findings.title: The announcement turns toward pain
findings.claim: The imperative to give good tidings keeps the favorable form of an announcement while its explicit content is punishment marked by pain, so the command becomes an ironic delivery of bad news whose consequence remains bodily felt.
findings.mechanism: The carrier بَشِّرْهُ belongs to the supplied good-news branch. Its independent complement عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ names punishment and pain; that contact activates the branch's context-limited ironic bad-news facet and makes pain the stated quality of the punishment.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears the command's reversal as a deliberate rhetorical turn, while the punishment and pain remain the actual announced outcome.
findings.containment: The act of announcing remains intact, and the favorable force matters as the form being reversed. The verse does not say that the addressee feels glad or generalize this bad-news use to every occurrence of the verb.

epistemic.reason: The exact imperative and its punishment-and-pain complement are supplied, and the registered facet expressly permits ironic bad-content use when the reversal is explicit.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sevindirici haber verme; kötü haberde açık nitelemeli alaycı bildirim
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kötü içerikli bildirim yalnızca kötülük açıkça söylendiğinde veya alaycı bir tersleme yapıldığında geçerlidir.
branch_activations.carrier: بَشِّرْهُ is the imperative announcement carrier, whose ordinary branch is favorable tidings.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate content words name punishment and specify it as painful.
branch_activations.activation: The favorable announcement form meets explicitly bad and painful content, satisfying the packet's condition for an ironic bad-news report.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The command retains the social form of good news while delivering its opposite in content.
branch_activations.boundary: This bad-news force depends on the explicit punishment content or ironic reversal; it is not generalized to unqualified uses of the verb.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişiye ağır acı verilir veya ağır bir ceza uygulanır.
branch_activations.carrier: عَذَابٍ names the punitive consequence in the announcement.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The announcement command and the separate painful adjective frame the punishment as an explicitly delivered and severe outcome.
branch_activations.activation: The noun's punishment sense meets the command that announces it and the adjective that qualifies its effect.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reversed announcement carries an actual punitive consequence, not only verbal irony.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus supports the punishment branch; no etymological account or unrelated hardship sense is added.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel anlam, kişide ya da canlı varlıkta bulunan acı ve ağrıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: أَلِيمٍ gives the punishment its painful quality.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The separate punishment noun supplies what the pain adjective qualifies.
branch_activations.activation: The experienced-pain facet meets a punishment carrier, making the consequence bodily perceptible rather than an abstract threat alone.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The reversal ends in pain borne by a living subject.
branch_activations.boundary: This is pain experienced by the subject; the branch does not claim that the word itself means causing another's pain.

findings.title: An acquired counterstream before the blocked ear
findings.claim: The purchased diversion in the preceding verse offers an attributed context for the ear-weight in 31:7: what first looked like an otherwise open message blocked at the ear can be reread as hearing already occupied by a chosen counterstream, while the verses may also be listing adjacent traits.
findings.mechanism: The HFT trace places deliberate purchase, diversionary occupation, renewed talk, deviation from guidance, and ridicule at supplied 31:6 word indices 4, 5, 6, 7, and 14. It returns through the focus hearing at 31:7:9:1 and weight at 31:7:13:1. In contact, acquired and ridiculing discourse can preload attention, making the focus's apparent blockage a downstream effect of diverted uptake; this causal connection remains attributed rather than explicit in the verse text.
findings.reader_payoff: The ear-weight can now suggest attention occupied by an acquired rival stream, alongside the still-live image of physical blockage; the refusal need not be read as simple incapacity alone.
findings.containment: The before-reading of an otherwise open message blocked at the ear remains available. The two verses do not explicitly identify one individual or state a causal link, and the supplied HFT record itself allows that they may place adjacent traits side by side. No gloss or facet is invented for unresolved context branches.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT coordinates, attributed roles, supplied Arabic anchors, and focus returns agree, but the reader identity is legacy_unbound, five context branch records are unresolved, and the causal connection is an inference from adjacency.

branch_activations.independent_trigger: The attributed 31:6 trace names purchased and diversionary discourse followed by talk and ridicule.
branch_activations.activation: The focus hearing carrier meets the preceding acquired counterstream, which the HFT role treats as displacing the act of taking in the signs.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The hearing clause may describe understanding that has been preempted by other discourse.
branch_activations.boundary: The relation is HFT-attributed contextual evidence; it does not independently prove that the two verses name the same person.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The change from blocked sound to preempted acceptance is available as an attributed contextual reading.
branch_activations.boundary: The extension is not a verified causal account; the source's adjacent-traits alternative remains live.

findings.title: Punishment beside reward
findings.claim: The painful punishment announced at the close of 31:7 is placed beside 31:8's believers, righteous deeds, and gardens of bliss, so the pericope sets refusal beside a contrasting response and outcome.
findings.mechanism: The focus's punishment announcement is the carrier; the next verse's statement about belief, righteous work, and gardens is the independent context trigger. Their adjacency makes the painful warning legible within a contrast of responses and outcomes.
findings.reader_payoff: The warning gains an explicit passage-level counterpart in reward, so its closing announcement does not stand as an isolated rhetorical sting.
findings.containment: The supplied verses support juxtaposition and contrast; they do not identify the same individual in both verses or establish an exhaustive two-outcome scheme.

epistemic.reason: Both verse texts are supplied and the punishment-versus-gardens contrast is directly visible, while treating the adjacency as a paired outcome is an interpretive connection.

The 31:8 contrast is assessed from its supplied verse text only because its target morphology is not provided.
